summary: CLINUVEL Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K furnishing an ASX announcement dated October 1, 2026, reporting clinical data rather than a corporate transaction. The release describes three adult vitiligo patients from the CUV105 trial in Kenya and the U.S. who received seven SCENESSE (afamelanotide) implants plus twice-weekly narrowband UVB phototherapy for 20 weeks (up to 41 sessions), with follow-up to 24 weeks. All three showed follicular and confluent repigmentation, well tolerated. No stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. Top-line CUV105 results are due December 2026, the operational catalyst to monitor.
